paper.title: Prediction-Assisted Pricing and Admission for LLM APIs with Stochastic Token Consumption

settings.name_in_paper: Sequential pricing and admission with stochastic resource consumption and offline predictions with a valid radius
unmapped: Learner receives offline predictions of every segment-product mean reward and resource vector with a known simultaneous sup-norm error radius epsilon
Learner knows per-product almost-sure resource envelopes u_a used for a pathwise reservation meter
Learner knows an upper bound Lambda_bar on the fluid LP's optimal dual (shadow price) l1 norm
m resources with consumption vectors in [0,1]^m; finitely many segments (contexts) observed before action, i.i.d. with probabilities q_x
Regret measured against fluid LP benchmark OPT(b)
settings.definition_quote: A request arrives with an observed segment $X_t\in\cX=\{1,\ldots,K\}$... the sequence is i.i.d. ... After action $A_t=a$ is offered, a purchase indicator $D_t(a)\in\{0,1\}$ is realized. Revenue is $R_t(a)=p_aD_t(a)\in[0,1]$... The resource vector is $C_t(a)\in[0,1]^m$... The policy must satisfy $\sum_{t=1}^T C_t(A_t)\le Tb$ componentwise on every sample path... simultaneous radius $\varepsilon\in[0,1]$ such that $|\widetilde r_{x,a}-r_{x,a}|\le\varepsilon$, $\|\widetilde c_{x,a}-c_{x,a}\|_\infty\le\varepsilon$

symbols.Lambda_bar: cap on the l1 norm of the projected shadow-price vector
symbols.Lambda_star: bound on the l1 norm of the fluid LP optimal dual between b' and b
symbols.W_sum: E[sum_t overline w_t], expected cumulative width of selected and true score-maximizing cells

conditions: prediction radius valid for all cells
stated on the simultaneous confidence event of Lemma 1

source.label: thm:generic
source.quote: Suppose \Cref{ass:dual} holds and the algorithm uses $\eta=\bar\Lambda/\sqrt{mT}$. On the event of \Cref{lem:confidence}, \Reg_T \le 2(1+\bar\Lambda)\E[\sum_{t=1}^T \overline w_t]+2\bar\Lambda\sqrt{mT}+T\Lambda_\star m\gamma+M_T+\delta T

results.notes: Regret is OPT(b) (fluid LP) minus expected revenue; mapped to pseudo_regret against best feasible policy. Statement mixes 'on the event' with an additive delta*T term for the complement; recorded as expectation.

symbols.Lambda_bar: cap on the l1 norm of the shadow-price vector
symbols.eps_pred: validated offline prediction error radius epsilon
symbols.J: number of segment-product cells, J = (number of segments) x (number of products)
symbols.M_T: expected number of reservation-meter overrides (O(1) w.h.p. if envelopes are o(T) and buffer dominates deviations)

conditions: prediction radius valid for all cells
tuning: gamma = c_0*sqrt(log(m*T/delta)/T), large enough to cover resource martingale and virtual-queue deviation

source.label: thm:main
source.quote: Under the assumptions above, choose $\gamma=c_0\sqrt{\frac{\log(mT/\delta)}{T}}$ large enough to cover the resource martingale and virtual-queue deviation. Then the expected regret of \PCUCB satisfies \Reg_T=\widetilde O(\sqrt{T}+(1+\bar\Lambda)\min\{T\varepsilon,\sqrt{JT}\}+M_T), where logarithmic factors depend on $J,m,T$, and $1/\delta$.

results.notes: Corollary 1 specialises: eps <~ 1/sqrt(T) gives O(sqrt T); uninformative prior gives O((1+Lambda_bar) sqrt(JT)). Dependence on m and Lambda_star hidden in O_tilde. Hard feasibility holds pathwise (Proposition 1).
